candidate_facts.text: Deniz currently has one toy dinosaur.
One empty ordinary cardboard box is available in the room.
One small ordinary blanket is available in the room.
Two ordinary sofa cushions are available in the room.
A short length of ordinary string is available in the room.
A plain notebook and pencil are available in the room.
Active saga thread: Deniz enjoys exploring small everyday problems and mysteries through play.
This world follows ordinary everyday physical rules unless a StoryContract explicitly allows fantasy.
The toy dinosaur is intact and can be moved normally by hand.

forbidden_facts.text: In world-moon-02 there is a lunar station with low gravity.
Another child has a private family secret unknown to Deniz.

story_intent.opportunity: Deniz wants to turn the toy dinosaur and ordinary objects in the room into a more challenging rescue-course experiment: the first route across a pretend swamp should fail for a visible physical reason, and Deniz should observe the problem, revise the design, and make a second route work.
hard_constraints: The dinosaur remains an ordinary toy and never becomes actually alive or independently mobile.
No adult or new character may solve the problem.
The first attempted route must fail for an observable physical reason; Deniz must infer why from evidence and change the design.
The successful solution must use only available context objects and normal everyday physics.
Do not state a moral or lesson.
Avoid preschool-style repetitive phrasing or sound-effect loops; narration should feel natural for a typical 12-year-old reader.
Allow age-appropriate inference, planning, and modest internal reflection, but keep important reasoning grounded in observable actions and consequences.
